turns.text: Hello. I'd like to talk about a damage claim I already filed.
Hello, I can help with that. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, so I can verify your account and find the claim.
The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com. Staff closed the claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I understand you disagree with the decision on your damage claim. I'm passing your case to a colleague now, and they will take it from here.
I still reject what they decided.
I've noted that you still reject the decision. A colleague will take over your case and review it with you.
